cases.description: rule resource.data.x in ['a','b']; where x in ['a','b']
rule resource.data.x in ['a','b']; where x in ['a','b','c']
rule resource.data.n > 0; where n >= 1 and n <= 1
collection group query, no filter, under match /{path=**}/cgt/{d} allow read: if true
collection group query, no filter, under a plain match /cgu/{d} allow read: if true
plain collection query under the plain match
plain collection query under the {path=**} match
collection group query scoped to the descendants of top/p, under the {path=**} match
collection group query under match /{path=**}/cgv/{d} allow read: if request.auth != null
collection group count under the {path=**} match

notes: Auth: an end-user ID token (actor user); the owner only seeds. Each case is a runQuery under a rule "allow list: if <cond>" whose filters are related to the condition; outcome OK is allow, PERMISSION_DENIED is deny. A document the query matches exists in each case.
Doubles are sent as doubleValue (d:3 is 3.0, d:-0 is -0.0).
